# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_FILL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Overnight gaps exceeding 0.5% in SPY tend to fill by midday, but the initial momentum in the gap direction often creates a trap for continuation traders. Fading the gap after an initial momentum bar that moves in the gap direction with sufficient range exploits the documented gap-fill asymmetry, allowing capture of the mean-reversion move as the gap fills.

## Mechanism

Entry: If the overnight gap (open - previous close) exceeds |0.5%| and the first 5-minute bar moves in the gap direction with a range >0.2% of price, then wait for a reversal candle that closes opposite the gap direction with volume >1.2× the average 5-minute volume of the first 5 bars and a close beyond the gap midpoint; enter at that candle's close in the opposite direction of the gap.
Exit: Stop at the extreme of the gap (gap high for a gap-up fade, gap low for gap-down fade); target at 50% gap fill (price halfway between open and prior close) or trail after 0.5R.
Regime: Works best when VIX < 20 and time is between 09:45-10:30; avoid days with major news (FOMC, earnings) where gaps may persist.
